snippet.title: Yume Nikki Fangame playthrough - ＊Illness＊
snippet.description:
Content warning:
- Blood and gore
- Violence

Read more about this fangame: https://ynfg.yume.wiki/%EF%BC%8AIllness%EF%BC%8A
